mechanics.mechanic: Open by defining the subject, connecting it to a closely related counterpart, and explaining why the relationship matters to the audience’s broader goals.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the topic is part of a larger system and the audience needs a reason to care before receiving technical detail.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid inflating the stakes with sweeping claims that are not later supported or narrowing the topic so much that important dependencies disappear.

mechanics.mechanic: Preview the major questions, practical outcomes, and level of technical depth the discussion will provide.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use near the beginning of a long explanation to give readers a map and distinguish conceptual background from actionable guidance.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid promising a complete solution or listing so many planned sections that the introduction becomes a table of contents.

mechanics.mechanic: Acknowledge that general background may already be familiar, then organize the explanation around the decisions or behaviors the audience wants to improve.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the audience is likely to know the basic vocabulary but lacks a usable framework.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid skipping essential definitions merely to reach recommendations quickly.

mechanics.function: Build a causal model in layers
mechanics.mechanic: Introduce one governing factor at a time, explain its role in plain language, then add the next factor and show how the two interact.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use for biological, technical, or behavioral systems in which several mechanisms jointly produce an outcome.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid presenting every component at once or implying that one factor fully explains a multi-factor process.

mechanics.function: Use an accessible analogy, then return to the mechanism
mechanics.mechanic: Translate an abstract process into a familiar comparison, use the comparison to establish intuition, and then restate the explanation in precise terms.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the subject involves invisible processes, delayed effects, or interactions that are difficult to visualize.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid allowing the analogy to replace the actual explanation or extending it beyond what it can accurately represent.

mechanics.mechanic: Present a general pattern, identify meaningful sources of variation, and frame personalization as a cautious process of observation rather than a universal prescription.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when responses may differ because of timing, genetics, context, baseline conditions, or tolerance.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid turning anecdotal experience into a rule, treating variability as a reason to abandon general guidance, or encouraging unsafe self-experimentation.

mechanics.mechanic: Raise likely questions before the audience has to ask them, then distinguish the standard case from exceptions and provide an alternative path for each exception.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when advice depends on environment, schedule, access, safety, or special circumstances.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid burying the main recommendation under exceptions or treating edge cases as evidence that the general pattern is invalid.

mechanics.mechanic: Separate established mechanisms, observed associations, personal judgment, and unresolved causality; use calibrated language for each category.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use whenever evidence quality varies or when a plausible explanation has not been proven to be causal.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid presenting correlation as causation, using the existence of studies as a substitute for explaining their relevance, or disguising opinion as consensus.

mechanics.function: Convert explanation into a practical sequence
mechanics.mechanic: After explaining the mechanism, specify the timing, conditions, intensity, fallback options, and safety boundaries that govern implementation.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use when the audience needs to translate theory into repeatable behavior.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid giving precise-looking instructions without explaining what changes them or omitting constraints that protect against misuse.

mechanics.function: Reinforce the central rule through spaced recaps
mechanics.mechanic: Pause at transitions to restate the core principle, connect it to the preceding mechanism, and preview how the next section extends or qualifies it.
mechanics.when_to_use: Use in long-form educational material with multiple technical sections or recurring variables.
mechanics.avoid: Avoid repeating wording mechanically, recapping details that do not advance the argument, or using summaries to introduce unsupported new claims.
